# AlgoCademy

> > AlgoCademy teaches problem-solving and algorithmic thinking to help software engineers land jobs at top tech companies like Google, Microsoft, and Amazon.

AlgoCademy is an interactive learning platform that provides comprehensive curriculum in algorithms, data structures, and coding interviews across multiple programming languages (Python, JavaScript, Java, C++). The platform combines traditional computer science fundamentals with AI-powered adaptive learning pathways and real-world interview preparation to help students transition into tech careers.

## Key Topics

- Algorithms
- Data Structures
- Big O Notation
- Complexity Analysis
- Coding Interviews
- Problem-Solving
- Python
- JavaScript
- Java
- C++
- Interview Preparation
- FAANG Companies
- Interactive Coding
- Algorithm Curriculum
- Practice Problems
